text: That Carkol from before...\c\nI guess it must’ve been here on a job.\nYou do know about Poké Jobs by now, right?[VAR 0114(0005)]

Looks like there’s no helping it, in that case...\c
Settle down and let Professor Hop teach you a
thing or two!\c
Let’s see if I can remember what Lee had written
down in his old notebooks...\c
Basically, you can have your Pokémon go about
and help companies or other folks who are in
need of something.\c
You can take Poké Jobs from the Rotomi at any
Pokémon Center, so give it a look sometime.[VAR 0114(0005)]

Now, I’m cream-crackered!
I’m for the Budew Drop Inn and some sleep.\c
Come tomorrow, that Fire Gym Leader Kabu
better be ready, because I’ll be coming for him![VAR 0114(0005)]
Burning the midnight oil, are we?\c\nIf you’re here for the Gym Challenge, you won’t\nbe able to challenge Kabu till the morning.
For now, it’d be best to simply get yourself a\ngood night’s rest at the Budew Drop Inn!
